name: 블록 아티팩트 그리드 분석
description: 분석합니다 JPEG block boundary 아티팩트 감지하기 위해 inconsistent compression grids 나타내는 변조.
algorithm: Block Artifact Grid (BAG) Extraction and Consistency Analysis
mechanism: JPEG 압축 creates an 8×8 block grid. When a region is spliced from a differently compressed source, the block grid alignment becomes inconsistent.
parameters: 블록 크기: 8×8, Grid 감지: cross-boundary 기울기, Alignment: phase 분석, Map: block visibility
source: Fan, Z. & de Queiroz, R. (2003) — Identification of Bitmap Compression History, IEEE TIP
useCase: Detecting spliced regions by finding JPEG 압축 grid 불일치

references.title: Fan, Z. & de Queiroz, R. (2003) — Identification of Bitmap Compression History, IEEE TIP

strengths:
• Directly linked to JPEG 압축
• Can localize tampered regions
• Well-understood theoretical basis
• Effective on single-compressed images
limitations:
• JPEG 이미지에서만 작동
• Double compression can mask 아티팩트
• Requires sufficient image quality
• May miss small tampered regions
